## Linked issues

<!--
GitHub only auto-closes an issue when this line uses its literal keyword
syntax immediately before the number — e.g. `Fixes #123`. A prose summary
like "Issues Fixed: #123" does NOT close anything, even though it looks
like it should — this is exactly what happened in PR #146 (v0.5.5): 11
completed issues shipped without closing and had to be fixed by hand.

Closing multiple issues: repeat the keyword for each one.
  Fixes #123, fixes #124, fixes #125

If this PR genuinely doesn't close any issue (pure refactor, docs, chore),
delete the line below and check the box instead — the "Linked issues" CI
check looks for one or the other.
-->
